# margin-and-measured-cost

Raising the margin to 3x is refused: a photo scan at 15 credits earns 4.16p at Max yearly, below
6p. Then 25 Apify runs at 3p each are measured (above the 1.31p fallback), so a live lookup at 15
credits now earns less than 2x its cost: it is priced at the floor, 22 credits, and flagged.
Raising it to 16 is refused (still below); 22 is accepted and priced as listed.
